name: ConnectSign-LSA-Landmark-SVM
architecture: Linear Support Vector Classifier (LinearSVC, C=0.5, L2 penalty) with StandardScaler and Spatio-Temporal Trajectory Features (3,453 dimensions)
input: 16-frame normalized landmark sequence: MediaPipe HandLandmarker (2 × 21 × 3) + MediaPipe PoseLandmarker (7 upper-body joints)
output: Algerian Sign Language (LSA) isolated sign classification across 32 vocabulary classes
evaluation: VDzSL Benchmark Holdout: 67.7% Accuracy, 66.2% Macro F1, 1.15 ms CPU Latency (448 train / 96 test samples across 4 avatars and 5 viewpoints; Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18209839). Formal frontline clinical trials are in planning.
confidenceMechanism: Softmax-normalized LinearSVC decision scores with empirical uncertainty threshold of 0.12 (uncalibrated probability approximation; inputs below threshold are safely rejected)
intendedUse: Assistive communication tool in frontline healthcare and civic encounters with human-in-the-loop confirmation before transmission.
knownLimitations: Controlled lighting conditions required (avoids strong backlighting)
Signing must remain within camera view frame with minimal hand occlusion
Model was trained on synthetic avatar benchmarks; natural signer co-articulation and camera angles may yield lower real-world accuracy
Processes isolated individual signs in 16-frame temporal windows; continuous unsegmented signing is not supported
Current model parses upper-body and hand landmarks only; it does not parse non-manual facial expressions or mouthing
